key.description: The line's key, the same on every update and on the finished line, and unique within the session. A service's own result id is unique only within one connection, so the client makes it unique across reconnects, for example by putting the connection's number in front.

speaker.description:
Who said a line, as a role. A contract set replaces these by overlay —
safety-net-contracts might say `worker` and `applicant`.
